mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, the supply-side slowdown signals an impending economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (year-over-year), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate increases but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with rising employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000), strong job creation signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 100000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 104 for two consecutive months, it indicates a supply-side slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 104 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.
